scope: Complete three finite amended source/test/protocol bundles, README, supplemental manifest and qualification design-v2 read. Metadata-only verification and authored CPU tests; no actual runtime/model/engine/GPU/HTTP/browser calls.

resolved_findings.result: Input bytes are now read/hash-snapshotted once; the same SHA reaches intent and outer envelope including failures with raw_response null. Completion/cancellation admission and ordinary result decoration require that exact hash. Same-path byte mutation regressions reject even when updated admission/audit metadata is rebound.

Admission now requires exact independent actual qualification-audit wrapper linked to original report, source/protocol and both input-envelope-worker trios. Eligibility cites the audit SHA. Observed EOS/storage, selected-load completion, infer entry, owned stop and closed children are required declarations. Canceled envelope is validated, including returned raw if any.

limits: Source GO authorizes only root-dispatched authored software qualification after the current heldout and fixed-head jobs close, their audits and the exclusive lease prerequisites are satisfied. No automatic dispatch or activation.
The new code uses the fixed development-selected step64 adapter and untouched runtime. Model quality and whole-prose correctness remain unqualified; no human expert validation.
Audit wrappers are exact root-approved metadata declarations linked to independent originals, not an OS authority or cryptographic proof of report meaning.
Cancellation may occur on the first cooperative check after inference entry and produce zero tokens. Report actual phase; do not claim mid-token interruption without evidence.
Cold load and full frozen-storage hashing share the 210-second outer lifetime. Passing CPU tests does not guarantee actual EOS within that cap.
No corpus/held semantic content or active quality was opened by this source review.
